tabs.tasksDesc: Action items pulled from your inbox

appearance.languageHelp: Choose the language used for menus, buttons, and other UI text. AI replies have a separate setting in the AI tab.
appearance.layoutFullWidth: Full width (one pane at a time)
appearance.layoutSplitDesc: Email list on the left, email content on the right
appearance.layoutFullWidthDesc: Email list takes full width; open email to read it

dialog.switchAccountConfirm: Any unsaved changes will be lost.

ai.title: AI Settings
ai.outputLanguageHelp: The language the assistant uses when writing replies, summaries, and extracted facts. "Same as UI" matches your Display language.
ai.providerHelp: Where AI requests are sent. Local options keep all data on this device.
ai.thinkingHelp: Display the model's intermediate reasoning when available.
ai.thinkingModeHelp: Chain-of-thought reasoning for supported models. Slower but more accurate.
ai.disableAiConfirm: AI features will stop running. You can re-enable them at any time.
ai.featuresHelp: When off, EmailOps runs as a plain email client — no chat, classification, embeddings, or background AI tasks.
ai.providerEmbeddedDesc: Bundled models. No server, no setup.
ai.routingModeHelp: How the chat decides between RAG retrieval and direct tool calls.
ai.keepAliveHelpStart: How long to keep the local model in RAM between chat turns. Higher values skip the slow GGUF reload — at the cost of memory. Use
ai.keepAliveHelpEnd: to evict immediately after use. Default: 30 minutes.
ai.ageCutoff: Limit AI processing to recent emails (days)
ai.ageCutoffHelp: Embeddings and classification are skipped for emails older than this many days. Helps keep CPU and disk usage in check on large mailboxes. Use 0 for no limit. Default: 365.
ai.contextWindowHelp: How many tokens the local model can attend to per turn. A larger window fits more retrieved email context but uses more memory and slows the first reply. Capped to the model's trained limit. Default: 8192.
ai.noCatalog: No model catalog available in this build.
ai.noLocalModels: No local models downloaded yet. Download one in AI Settings first.
ai.outputLanguageSaveFailed: Failed to save AI output language: {{error}}
ai.ageCutoffSaveFailed: Failed to save AI age cutoff: {{error}}
ai.reindexStarting: Embedding model changed → re-indexing all emails…
ai.disabledLog: AI features disabled — local AI data preserved

confirmDisable.title: Disable AI features?
confirmDisable.body: Chat, AI Search, Classification, Memory, and Tasks will be hidden.
confirmDisable.preserved: Your existing AI data is preserved.
confirmDisable.preservedDetail: Embeddings, memories, tasks, classifications, and chat history stay in your local database. Re-enable any time and everything reappears instantly. Nothing is deleted.

chatPrompts.title: Chat prompts
chatPrompts.description: Edit the instructions sent to the AI during chat. The system prompt frames every chat turn; the advanced prompts only run inside the retrieval pipeline (HyDE rewrite + reranker) and most users will never need to touch them.

promptEditor.resetBody: “{{label}}” will be restored to its built-in default. Your customisations will be lost.
promptEditor.noVariables: This prompt has no template variables.
promptEditor.variablesHelp: Click to insert at the cursor.

classification.title: Email Classification
classification.description: Automatic priority, intent, and topic tagging.
classification.autoClassifyDesc: Automatically classify emails after sync using AI.
classification.classifyInHelp: Only emails in the selected Gmail inbox tabs will be classified.
classification.noCategoriesSelected: No categories selected — no emails will be classified.
classification.promptDescription: The instructions sent to the AI for each email being classified. The email's From / Subject / Preview is appended automatically — focus on the rules.
classification.rulesIntro: Rules match emails by sender/subject pattern and assign tags instantly (no AI needed). Use
classification.patternRequired: At least one pattern (sender or subject) is required
classification.noRulesYet: No rules yet. Default rules will be created on first sync.

tasks.title: AI Tasks
tasks.description: When enabled, the assistant scans new emails for action items and adds them to your Tasks panel.
tasks.experimentalDesc: Track follow-ups and waiting-on-them items derived from your inbox. Master switch — when off, no task LLM call runs (sync-time or backfill) and the sidebar entry is hidden. Existing tasks are preserved.
tasks.enablePrompt: Enable AI Tasks above to configure extraction, exclusions, tuning, and the prompt.
tasks.extractOnSyncDesc: Run task extraction automatically after each sync.
tasks.selfOnly: Learn only from emails I wrote
tasks.selfOnlyDesc: Real commitments live in your outbound mail. When on, only emails you sent produce tasks; inbound emails still update awaiting-reply state.
tasks.backfillDescription: Process older eligible emails using the task-only extraction marker. Memory facts are not reset or consumed by this operation.
tasks.gmailCategoriesDesc: Only emails in these Gmail categories feed task extraction. Uncheck all to allow every category.
tasks.excludedTagsDesc: Emails whose classification tags match any of these values skip task extraction. Defaults filter out newsletters/marketing/sales/hiring/promotion.
tasks.maxTasksPerEmailHint: Upper bound on tasks extracted from a single email. 1 = focus on the single most important action.
tasks.backfillDaysHint: Only extract tasks from emails received in the last N days. 0 = no window.
tasks.extractionPromptDesc: Edit the instructions sent to the AI when pulling tasks from each email. The email's From / Subject / body is appended automatically.
tasks.taskExtractionDesc: Pulls action items, commitments, and deadlines from each email.
tasks.resetExtractionLog: Reset task extraction for {{count}} emails — run task backfill to re-process them

lenses.title: AI Lenses
lenses.experimentalDesc: Lenses are AI-extracted, schema-typed views over your mailbox. Master switch — when off, the Lenses sidebar entry is hidden and lenses don't run. Your saved lenses are preserved.
lenses.enablePrompt: Enable AI Lenses above to create and run saved views over your inbox.
lenses.enabledInfo: Create and manage individual lenses from the Lenses entry in the sidebar.

memory.title: AI Memory
memory.description: Extracted facts give the assistant long-term context across conversations.
memory.experimentalDesc: Inspect what the assistant has learned about your contacts, domains, and projects. Master switch — when off, no extraction, consolidation, or header injection runs and the sidebar entry is hidden. Your stored data is preserved.
memory.enablePrompt: Enable AI Memory above to configure extraction, exclusions, tuning, and prompts.
memory.extractOnSyncDesc: Run per-email extraction automatically after each sync.
memory.selfOnly: Learn only from emails I wrote
memory.selfOnlyDesc: Durable preferences, decisions, and commitments live in your outbound mail. When on, only emails you sent produce facts and tasks; inbound emails still update thread summaries and awaiting-reply state.
memory.gmailCategoriesDesc: Only emails in these Gmail categories feed the memory. Uncheck all to allow every category.
memory.excludedTagsDesc: Emails whose classification tags match any of these values skip task and memory extraction. Defaults filter out newsletters/marketing/sales/hiring/promotion.
memory.consolidationIntervalHint: 0 disables the periodic ticker. Consolidation still runs after each sync.
memory.promoteThresholdHint: Score at which a candidate fact becomes promoted (0–1).
memory.candidateTtlHint: Low-scoring candidates older than this are retired.
memory.eventRetentionHint: Interaction events older than this are pruned by the dream job.
memory.backfillBatchSizeHint: Emails processed per backfill batch. Larger = faster but heavier on the model.
memory.backfillSectionDesc: Backfill runs extraction over emails that haven't been processed yet. It uses the categories and exclusions above. Consolidation scores candidate facts, promotes, dedupes, and prunes.
memory.selectAccountWarn: Select an active account to run backfill or consolidation.
memory.resetExtractionTitle: Clear extraction state so all emails are re-processed on the next backfill
memory.extractionPromptDesc: Edit the instructions sent to the AI when pulling durable facts from each email. The email's From / Subject / body is appended automatically. Task extraction has its own prompt in the AI Tasks settings.
memory.factExtractionDesc: Pulls durable facts and preferences from each email.
memory.resetExtractionLog: Reset extraction for {{count}} emails — run backfill to re-process them

aiDrafts.title: AI drafts
aiDrafts.description: Generate reply drafts for incoming messages.
aiDrafts.enableDesc: Show the "AI Draft" button next to Reply All. Drafts are generated locally via your configured AI provider and grounded with similar past threads from this account.
aiDrafts.personaHelpStart: One sentence describing who the AI is writing as. Substituted into
aiDrafts.writingStyleHelpStart: Voice, tone, and structural preferences. Substituted into
aiDrafts.promptHelpStart: Full template the AI receives. Placeholders:
aiDrafts.promptHelpEnd: . Anything else is passed through as literal text.

aiSearch.title: AI search
aiSearch.description: Embedding generation and semantic search options.
aiSearch.regenerateConfirm: Regenerating embeddings clears existing vectors. Continue?
aiSearch.selectAccount: Select an account to configure AI Search.
aiSearch.categoriesHelp: Only emails in these categories will be embedded for semantic search. Embeddings power "find similar" and natural-language search across your mailbox. Leave only Primary selected to keep the index small and fast; add more categories if you want search to cover newsletters, social, or promotions.
aiSearch.noCategoriesWarn: No categories selected — no new emails will be embedded.
aiSearch.rebuildHelp: Deletes every embedding for this account and regenerates them from scratch. Use this after changing the embedding model or the categories above. Runs in the background and processes the entire mailbox in batches; progress appears in the output panel.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.subtitle: Privacy & security
privacy.passwordHelp: A main password locks the app on startup. You must enter it before EmailOps becomes usable.
privacy.lockedDesc: App is locked on startup until the correct password is entered.
privacy.noPasswordDesc: No password is set — the app opens without any lock screen.
privacy.remoteContentHelp: When disabled, images and other remote resources in emails are blocked until you explicitly allow them.
privacy.trustedSendersHelp: Senders allowed to load remote images automatically.
privacy.allowRemoteToggleDesc: When off, external images and trackers are blocked. A banner lets you load them per-email.

passwordDialog.minLengthError: Password must be at least 6 characters.
